note: First-class OAuth2 / OpenID Connect security with scopes. vespera! security_schemes: oauth2 schemes declare flows = { implicit | password | client_credentials | authorization_code = { authorization_url, token_url, refresh_url, scopes = { "scope" = "description" } } } (required URLs per flow checked at compile time; flows on other types rejected); openIdConnect keeps open_id_connect_url. #[route(security = [...])] and top-level vespera!(security = [...]) accept ("oauth2", ["read:users"]) scoped requirements, ["apiKey", ("oauth2", [..])] AND groups and a [] optional-auth alternative, emitted as OpenAPI security requirement objects. Compile errors for unknown schemes and for scopes no flow of the oauth2 scheme declares. vespera_core: SecurityRequirement alias, OAuthFlows::declares_scope / scope_names. vespera_inprocess: Principal::require_scopes -> InsufficientScope (403 + WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="insufficient_scope").
